Meeting Date:                  1/27/2021
Sponsor(s):                   Rodriguez Sanchez (33)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 7-1 at 3109-3133 N Elston
                              Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                     ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all ofthe M1-1,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Parl< District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 7-1 in the area bound by:

      the alley next northeast of and parallel to North Elston Avenue; North Washtenaw
      Avenue; North Elston Avenue; and a line 297.85 feet northwest ofthe intersection of
      North Elston Avenue and North Washtenaw Avenue as measured along the northwest
      right of way,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse, Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                        Rossana Rodriguez-Sanchez
                                                        Alderman, 33'" Ward




Common Address:
3109-3133 N. Elston Avenue
